title: Hook-first: Perfect drop opener into rapid stacking and dramatic topple

clips.why: Opens on the golden 'PERFECT!' drop burst for immediate visual payoff.
Shows the tap-to-drop control and overhang slicing mechanic clearly.
Demonstrates rapid stacking and color-shifting blocks as the tower grows.
Escalates precision stakes as sliced blocks become noticeably narrower.
Builds tension on a narrow purple block before a dramatic missed drop.
Highlights the score summary and instant retry button.
Shows a fresh 45-second run starting immediately and ending in a quick fail.
Displays the Sky Stack logo, tagline, and INSTALL call to action.
